Pictorial map. Covers Gansu, Shanxi, Shanxi, Henan, Shandong, Jiangnan. Shows the complete course of the Yellow River form the headstream in the Tibet plateau to the old estuary, prior to 1853, in Jiangnan Province. Relief shown pictorially. Cover title. Brush-and-ink and watercolor. Oriented with north to the bottom. Oriental collection, miscellaneous #7. Includes text. Scale [ca. 1:400,000]. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. AACR2 Previous call number: G7822.Y4N22 1820 .L5 Vault Shelf Filed in the same box with G7822.G7N22 1820 .S5 Vault Shelf.
